ab: Hacking and tech support ('guy in the chair')
Swapping places with Carol and Monica
Appears as the viewer's most admired person
Chemical mind control of the Widows
Commands spread by an airborne virus

terrigen.props: Crystals that release a mist when broken, setting off Terrigenesis: people with Inhuman genes are cocooned and come out with powers. Ordinary humans exposed to it turn to stone or die.
terrigen.cont: Jiaying's Inhumans kept the crystals at Afterlife, their hidden sanctuary, to transform their own people.

tesseract.origin: Asgardian (the jewel of Odin's treasure room); holds the Space Stone
tesseract.props: A glowing blue cube that holds the Space Stone. Its energy powers weapons and engines and opens portals across space.
tesseract.cont: S.H.I.E.L.D. kept it for decades, from Camp Lehigh to Fury's research facility; Asgard locked it in Odin's vault, and the TVA confiscated a variant's cube.

scepter.origin: Its gem holds the Mind Stone, an Infinity Stone
scepter.props: A golden spear whose blue gem holds the Mind Stone. A touch of its tip to the chest takes over a mind, it fires energy blasts, and HYDRA used it to give test subjects powers.
scepter.cont: S.H.I.E.L.D. took it after the Battle of New York, where HYDRA agents inside it kept it for experiments; the Avengers then held it after Sokovia, and Valentina displays it at her gala in Washington, D.C..

aether.origin: Older than the universe; the Reality Stone, an Infinity Stone
aether.props: A fluid, red mist that can enter and take over a living host. As the Reality Stone, it can turn matter into dark matter and bend reality into illusions.
aether.cont: Bor's Asgardians hid it on a world no one could reach; later Sif and Volstagg left it with the Collector, who kept it on display in his museum on Knowhere.

orb.origin: Infinity Stone (the Power Stone), from before the universe
orb.props: A metal sphere that seals in the purple Power Stone. Any ordinary being who touches the bare stone is destroyed, and its power can wipe out a planet.
orb.cont: After Ronan's defeat the Guardians handed it to the Nova Corps, who locked it in a vault on Xandar.

agamotto.props: An amulet that holds the Time Stone, letting its wearer turn time back, freeze it or trap it in a loop. Even empty, its light can reveal hidden things.
agamotto.cont: The Masters of the Mystic Arts guarded it at Kamar-Taj, where the Ancient One kept the Time Stone.

gauntlet.props: A golden gauntlet made to hold all six Infinity Stones and channel their combined power. With it, one snap wipes out half of all life.

nano-gauntlet.origin: Built by Tony Stark, Bruce Banner and Rocket
nano-gauntlet.props: A Stark nanotech gauntlet built to hold all six Infinity Stones. Bruce uses it to bring back everyone lost in the Snap.

mjolnir.props: Only the worthy can lift it. It returns to the hand that threw it, calls lightning and lets its wielder fly.
mjolnir.cont: S.H.I.E.L.D. walled it in where it fell in New Mexico; no one could lift it.
mjolnir.quote: Whosoever holds this hammer, if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor.

stormbreaker.props: An Uru axe-hammer with a handle grown by Groot. It calls lightning, returns when thrown and can summon the Bifrost.

shield.props: A round, nearly indestructible vibranium shield that absorbs impacts. When thrown, it ricochets and comes back.
shield.cont: The Smithsonian displayed it after Sam gave it up, until the U.S. government handed it to John Walker.

hawkeye-bow.props: A high-tension compound bow, which Clint fires with near-perfect aim. It's matched with a quiver of specialized trick arrows.

trick-arrows.props: Arrows with special heads: explosive, taser, pulse, flare, grappling cable, and Pym Particle tips that shrink or grow things.

widows-bite.props: Wrist gauntlets that deliver electric shocks on contact. They can also fire or plant stun discs from a distance.

star-lord-blasters.props: A pair of handheld quad-barrel energy blasters that fire plasma bolts. Quill often fires them two at a time.

iron-man-armor.props: A powered suit of armor that flies, fires repulsor blasts and missiles, and runs on an arc reactor. Later models assemble remotely or flow out of a nanotech housing.

mark-i.origin: Built by Tony Stark and Ho Yinsen in a Ten Rings cave
mark-i.props: A bulky, crude iron suit powered by Tony's first arc reactor. It carries flamethrowers and has a short-burst rocket for flight.
mark-i.cont: The Ten Rings gathered its wreckage from the desert, and Raza handed it to Obadiah Stane, who copied the design.

war-machine.origin: Stark prototype, weaponized by Hammer Industries
war-machine.props: A gunmetal Stark suit of armor fitted with heavy weapons, including a shoulder-mounted gun. It flies like Iron Man's armor.

hulkbuster.props: A giant, heavily armored suit built to restrain the Hulk. Its orbital module, Veronica, drops it in and sends replacement parts mid-fight.

cap-uniform.props: A red, white and blue combat uniform with a star on the chest. Later versions add armor plating.

falcon-wings.props: A jet-powered wingpack that lets its wearer fly and maneuver at high speed. Later versions add guns and the Redwing drone.

bucky-arm.origin: HYDRA (Winter Soldier program); later Wakandan vibranium
bucky-arm.props: A cybernetic arm of great strength. The first is metal with a red star; Wakanda's replacement is vibranium.

black-panther-suit.props: A vibranium-weave suit with retractable claws. Shuri's nanotech version forms from a necklace and absorbs kinetic energy to release it as a blast.

spider-man-suit.origin: Stark Industries; later homemade by Peter Parker
spider-man-suit.props: Tony's suits carry an AI (Karen), adjustable lenses, web-wings and many web settings. After the spell, Peter makes his own suits, sewn by hand and later built and repaired with a homemade Fabricator.

iron-spider.props: A red-and-gold nanotech suit that forms around Peter, with four mechanical spider legs and an 'instant kill' mode.

ant-man-suit.props: A suit and helmet that use Pym Particles to shrink its wearer to insect size, keeping full strength, or grow to giant size. The helmet lets the wearer talk to and command ants.

carol-suit.props: A Kree Starforce uniform that changes its colors on command, with a helmet that forms over her head.

thanos-armor.props: Golden armor and a crested helmet that Thanos wears into battle.

arc.origin: Stark Industries (Tony's miniature version, built in a Ten Rings cave)
arc.props: A miniature arc reactor in Tony's chest that keeps shrapnel from his heart and powers his armor. Its palladium core poisons him until he builds a new element.
arc.quote: Proof that Tony Stark has a heart

web-shooters.origin: Peter Parker's homemade design; later Stark-built
web-shooters.props: Wrist devices that fire synthetic web fluid in many settings, from lines and nets to ricochet and taser webs.

chitauri-tech.props: Alien energy rifles, flying chariots and huge armored Leviathans. Salvaged parts power weapons that can blast through walls.
chitauri-tech.cont: S.H.I.E.L.D. confiscated a Chitauri gun and locked a virus-carrying helmet in its Sandbox lab, the Avengers seized Chitauri gear at Strucker's base, and Valentina displays relics at her gala in Washington, D.C..

cloak.origin: Relic of the Masters of the Mystic Arts (New York Sanctum)
cloak.props: A sentient red cloak that chooses its wearer. It lets him levitate and fly, and it fights on its own.

sling-ring.props: A two-finger ring that lets a trained sorcerer open portals to other places by tracing a circle in the air.

casket.props: A glowing blue casket that unleashes ice and bitter cold, enough to freeze a world. It is the source of the Frost Giants' power.
casket.cont: Odin locked it in his vault in Asgard.

pym.props: Particles that shrink or enlarge people and objects by changing the distance between their atoms. Shrinking far enough reaches the Quantum Realm.

vibranium.props: A rare, nearly indestructible metal that absorbs vibrations and kinetic energy.

herb.props: A glowing purple herb that gives the Black Panther enhanced strength, speed and senses. Taking it also sends the drinker to the ancestral plane.
herb.cont: Wakanda tended the herb in a sacred garden, kept for the Black Panther's ritual, and Shuri later replants it.

helicarrier.props: A flying aircraft carrier held aloft by four giant rotors. Reflective panels can make it invisible.
helicarrier.cont: Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. kept one of Fury's old carriers hidden and refitted it under the Theta Protocol.

quinjet.props: A vertical-takeoff jet with a stealth cloak, used to carry agents and Avengers on missions.

milano.props: A small orange-and-blue spaceship, an M-ship, that serves as Quill's home and the Guardians' transport.

benatar.props: The Guardians' larger spaceship, which replaces the Milano.

mix.props: A cassette mixtape of 1960s and ’70s pop songs Peter's mother made him, played on his Walkman.

compass.props: A pocket compass Steve keeps with a photo of Peggy Carter in its lid.

sokovia-accords.props: A legal agreement, ratified by 117 countries, that puts enhanced people and the Avengers under a U.N. panel's control. Under it, registered Inhumans must wear tracking bracelets.

tempad.props: A handheld TVA device that opens time doors to other places and times. It runs out of power and needs charging.

reset-charges.props: TVA devices that wipe out a branched timeline when set off. Planted across the Sacred Timeline, they instead branch it.

darkhold.origin: Copied from spells carved at Mount Wundagore
darkhold.props: An ancient book of dark magic, the Book of the Damned, that corrupts whoever reads it. Its spells include dreamwalking into other universes.
darkhold.cont: S.H.I.E.L.D. hid the book away, at last in the Koenigs' Labyrinth, before Ghost Rider carried it off through a portal.

rings.props: Ten metal rings worn on the forearms that give their wielder immense power and long life. They fly, strike and fire energy at their bearer's command.

necrosword.props: A cursed black sword that lets its wielder kill gods and summon shadow monsters. It slowly corrupts and kills its bearer.

bangle.props: A gold bangle that unlocks its wearer's latent powers, letting Kamala make hard-light constructs. It is one of a pair of Quantum Bands; with the other, Dar-Benn tears open jump points.

surfer-board.props: A silver board the Silver Surfer rides through space and across Earth at tremendous speed.

st-billyclub.props: Batons that holster on Daredevil's suit and split into two clubs or join into one. A steel cable inside lets him swing and grapple.

st-dd-suit.props: An armored red bodysuit with a horned cowl, built to turn knives and blunt blows.

st-skull-vest.props: A bulletproof tactical vest with a white skull painted on the front.

wakandan-vibranium.props: The strongest metal on Earth, from a meteorite that struck Wakanda. It absorbs vibrations and powers all of Wakanda's technology.
wakandan-vibranium.cont: Wakanda hides its vibranium behind its cloaked border, and its Hatut Zeraze spies recover pieces taken from the kingdom.
